role: Build a host-side transcript-pairing checker for e2e-status.jsonl logs: pair begin/end events, flag unmatched begins, unmatched ends, duplicate ends, out-of-order events, and missing terminal status events; test against the known-good rehearsal transcript and a synthetic corrupted transcript
deliverables: check_transcript.py   (task 2: host-side begin/end pairing checker, exit code 0 clean / 1 defects)
test-results.json + TEST-RESULTS.md (task 3: checker output on rehearsal + corrupted transcripts)
bounds: <=40 tool calls; no nested subagents; no network; existing files elsewhere read-only; CLAIM.json first, REPORT.md last
honesty: Checker validates event discipline only (pairing/order/terminal status); it does not execute the console E2E or judge gameplay outcomes. Known-good expectation (21 begins / 20 ends / 0 failed / 1 unmatched refusal-probe begin) comes from the task brief and is verified against the rehearsal transcript itself.
